title: Senior Network Security Engineer - DGX Cloud
description_html: NVIDIA is seeking a Sr Network Security Engineer to implement and maintain robust security across on-premise and cloud environments - enabling business verticals that span Graphics Drivers to AI and Deep Learning. In this role, you will lead the deployment and management of critical security infrastructure, including next-generation firewalls, load balancers, and advanced threat detection systems, safeguarding our hybrid cloud and on-premise networks while driving compliance across the organization. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in multi-cloud architectures and cybersecurity, a proven track record of supporting large-scale, high-availability networks, and hands-on experience operating with hyperscaling environments. You’re a decisive problem-solver who thrives in fast-paced settings and moves with urgency to meet the demands of modern infrastructure.      What You Will Be Doing:     Design & Integrate:  Collaborate with the network architecture team to review and comment on network designs.     Manage & Optimize Infrastructure:  Lead the deployment, management, and troubleshooting of firewall, load balancing, and IDS/IPS solutions across both on-premise and cloud environments.     Enhance Visibility & Intelligence:  Evolve our security feature set by using telemetry and advanced analytics to improve network observability and proactive threat detection.     Governance & Compliance:  Define and maintain comprehensive security guidelines for on-premise and cloud deployments, ensuring consistent alignment with compliance and defense-in-depth standards.     Threat Mitigation:  Orchestrate rigorous vulnerability management, including patching and bug scrubs, to proactively eliminate potential threat vectors.     IAM Strategy:  Design Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies and controls specifically for services owned and operated by the global networking team.     Operational Excellence:  Serve as a key stakeholder in security reviews and ACL approvals, ensuring safe, efficient, and resilient network operations.     Incident Response & Triage:  Lead incident response efforts by investigating security alerts, conducting root cause analysis, and executing remediation plans in alignment with security incident handling frameworks.     Operational Enablement:  Partner with the global operations team to ensure they have the necessary operational tools, documentation, and actionable information required to provide rapid first-response to network and security incidents.        What We Need To See:     Network & Cloud Security Architecture:  Proven expertise in secure cloud-native and hybrid network architectures across major CSPs (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI), ensuring seamless connectivity and stringent security posture.     Secure Network Infrastructure:  Proficiency in securely deploying and managing Fortigate (FortiManager), Arista, Cisco, and Cumulus OS devices.     Advanced Threat Protection:  Comprehensive operational knowledge of IDS/IPS, SSL inspection, URL filtering, and anti-malware/bot mitigations to maintain high-throughput secured traffic.     Virtualization & Connectivity:  Strong understanding of network virtualization (VRFs, VxLAN) and CSP-specific virtualized firewall deployments.     Dynamic Routing Protocols:  Proficient in dynamic routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, IS-IS to ensure resilient and efficient network connectivity.     Monitoring & Observability:  Experience managing logging pipelines and telemetry tools such as Splunk and Grafana for proactive security oversight.     Professional Experience:  8+ years of dedicated network security experience with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, coupled with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with global security teams.         Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:     Multi-Cloud Security Expertise:  Deep proficiency in OCI, GCP, AWS, and Azure cybersecurity frameworks.     Infrastructure Proficiency:  Working knowledge of Mellanox/Cumulus OS and network routing paradigms.     Automation & AI-Assisted Development:  Proven ability to leverage Python, Shell scripting, and AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to build efficient automation, frameworks, and operational dashboards.     Large-Scale Experience:  Demonstrated success in designing and securing hyper-scale network environments.     Innovation Outlook:  Passion for driving progress through the adoption of groundbreaking technologies.           NVIDIA is leading the way in ground breaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for great people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence.      Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 264,500 USD for Level 4, and 208,000 USD - 333,500 USD for Level 5.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 26, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Cloud Engineer 5
description_html: Cloud Engineer 5      Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive   ,    and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking   Cloud Engineers   who are passionate about marrying data with emerging technologies to join our team. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving a major transformation within Capital One.      What You’ll Do:      Lead the adoption and responsible use of emerging AI and automation capabilities to improve the scalability, reliability, and efficiency of cloud platforms and engineering workflows      Lead a portfolio of diverse technology projects and a team of developers with deep experience in scalable cloud infrastructure to create solutions that help meet regulatory needs for the company      Share your passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal & external technology communities, mentoring other members of the engineering community      Collaborate with digital product managers, and deliver robust cloud-based solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of Americans achieve financial empowerment      Utilize programming languages like Java, Scala, Python, Go, and Node.js, Container Orchestration services including Docker and Kubernetes, and a variety of cloud provider tools and services      Provide technical leadership across multiple teams, shaping system architecture and long-term technology direction      Drive end-to-end design and implementation of large-scale, distributed, or cloud-native systems with high reliability and performance requirements      Partner with architects and product leaders to define platform roadmaps and shared services strategy      Proactively identify areas for improvement and contribute to efforts that ensure well-managed cloud solutions      Influence long-term technology strategy through evaluation of emerging tools and practices in a ‘you build it, you own it’ environment      Integrate risk awareness into daily work, proactively considering potential issues related to cybersecurity, regulatory compliance (OBL, SOX), audits, and change management      Lead complex design and implementation efforts for distributed or cloud-native systems, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability        Basic Qualifications:      Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)      At least 7 years of experience in software engineering (Internship experience does not apply)      At least 2 years of experience in cloud engineering        Preferred Qualifications:      Master’s Degree in Computer Science or related field      8+ years of experience in coding with at least one of the following: Java, Scala, Python, Go, or Node.js      4+ years of experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI)      4+ years of experience in CI/CD orchestration, Infrastructure-as-Code frameworks (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Crossplane), and Automated Governance using Policy-as-Code DSLs (e.g. OPA)      One or more active certifications related to cloud infrastructure management or security      Experience with distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native patterns (e.g., Kubernetes, Serverless)      Experience designing and supporting cloud networking, security and identity integrations      Experience troubleshooting and supporting production cloud environments      Experience leveraging AI-driven tooling to automate cloud operations, improve platform reliability, or optimize infrastructure performance and cost      Experience leading cross-functional engineering efforts or large-scale technical initiatives      Experience influencing technology strategy at the portfolio or business unit level         Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. title: Technical Program Manager , AI/ML
description_html: Job Requisition ID #                      26WD101205       L'affichage de poste en français suivra / The French job posting follows.      26WD101205, Technical Program Manager , AI/ML     Position Overview   The Platform Services and Emerging Technologies (PSET) team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive successful delivery of Autodesk's Generative AI Accelerator (GAIA) outcomes.    In this role, you will drive complex, cross-functional programs that move emerging AI capabilities from research into production. You will partner closely with research, engineering, architecture, data, security, legal, and product leadership so that new AI capabilities are delivered responsibly, predictably, and at scale.   This role requires strong technical depth including AI fluency, excellent execution discipline, and the ability to operate effectively across organizations to align priorities, manage risk, and drive outcomes in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.    Responsibilities    Drive end-to-end delivery of GAIA program outcomes, from experimentation through production readiness and adoption    Drive the business outcomes realized through delivery of AI/ML capabilities, partnering with engineering teams and leadership across product integration, platform adoption, and operational scalability    Build and maintain integrated delivery plans across research and engineering teams, ensuring clear milestones, dependencies, and risk management    Drive delivery forecasting, execution tracking, and transparent reporting across program lifecycles  Orchestrate delivery across research, engineering, security, legal, product, and platform teams, following changes downstream to everything they touch    Partner with executive stakeholders, architects, and product leaders to shape strategy, sequencing, and execution plans    Provide clear, actionable status reporting at both executive and team levels, including risks, tradeoffs, and mitigation strategies  Anticipate dependencies and risks rather than discover them, across data, model readiness, and delivery timelines    Support teams with impediment removal, exception handling, and dependency resolution    Use approved AI tools and automation responsibly to create visibility, repeatability, and a single source of truth across delivery, while validating outputs and maintaining human judgment  Champion Agile and Lean delivery practices, supporting self-organizing teams operating in complex environments    Use evidence and validated learning to adapt plans, improving delivery effectiveness, collaboration, and program outcomes    Act as a change agent, helping teams navigate evolving requirements, research uncertainty, and platform priorities     Minimum Qualifications    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field    5+ years of experience delivering complex, cross-team initiatives in fast-paced technical environments    3+ years in a TPM, Product Manager, Software Architect, or similar role    Strong understanding of cloud platforms and distributed systems, including APIs and services on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud    Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and the software development lifecycle, including how AI-assisted tools are used in delivery    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical audiences    Strong problem-solving skills with a bias toward action and outcomes     Preferred Qualifications    Experience delivering AI/ML, Generative AI, data platform, or research-to-production programs    Familiarity with AI systems such as model training and evaluation, inference and serving, or retrieval and vector databases    Understanding of Responsible AI, data governance, privacy, and compliance concepts    Passion for operational excellence, process improvement, and scalable delivery practices    --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------   26WD101205 Responsable de programme technique, IA/ML      Aperçu du Poste     L'équipe « Platform Services and Emerging Technologies » (PSET) recherche un responsable de programme technique (TPM) chargé de piloter la mise en œuvre réussie des résultats du programme « Generative AI Accelerator » (GAIA) d'Autodesk.     À ce poste, vous piloterez des programmes complexes et transversaux visant à faire passer les capacités émergentes en IA de la recherche à la production. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de la recherche, de l’ingénierie, de l’architecture, des données, de la sécurité, des affaires juridiques et des produits afin de garantir que les nouvelles capacités d’IA soient mises en œuvre de manière responsable, prévisible et à grande échelle.    Ce poste exige de solides connaissances techniques, notamment une maîtrise approfondie de l’IA, une excellente discipline d’exécution et la capacité à intervenir efficacement au sein de différentes structures organisationnelles pour aligner les priorités, gérer les risques et obtenir des résultats dans des environnements ambigus et en constante évolution.      Responsabilités      Piloter la mise en œuvre de bout en bout des résultats du programme GAIA, de l’expérimentation à la mise en production et à l’adoption      Piloter les résultats commerciaux obtenus grâce à la mise en œuvre des capacités d’IA/ML, en partenariat avec les équipes d’ingénierie et les responsables dans les domaines de l’intégration des produits, de l’adoption de la plateforme et de l’évolutivité opérationnelle      Élaborer et maintenir des plans de mise en œuvre intégrés entre les équipes de recherche et d’ingénierie, en garantissant la clarté des jalons, des dépendances et de la gestion des risques      Piloter les prévisions de mise en œuvre, le suivi de l’exécution et le reporting transparent tout au long du cycle de vie des programmes    Orchestrer la mise en œuvre entre les équipes de recherche, d’ingénierie, de sécurité, juridiques, produit et de plateforme, en suivant les répercussions en aval sur tout ce qu’elles touchent      Collaborer avec les parties prenantes de la direction, les architectes et les responsables produit pour définir la stratégie, l’enchaînement des étapes et les plans d’exécution      Fournir des rapports d’état clairs et exploitables tant au niveau de la direction qu’au niveau des équipes, incluant les risques, les compromis et les stratégies d’atténuation    Anticiper les dépendances et les risques plutôt que de les découvrir a posteriori, qu’il s’agisse des données, de l’état de préparation des modèles ou des délais de mise en œuvre      Soutenir les équipes en éliminant les obstacles, en gérant les exceptions et en résolvant les dépendances      Utiliser de manière responsable les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés pour garantir la visibilité, la reproductibilité et une source unique de vérité tout au long de la livraison, tout en validant les résultats et en préservant le jugement humain    Promouvoir les pratiques de livraison Agile et Lean, en soutenant les équipes auto-organisées évoluant dans des environnements complexes      S’appuyer sur des données factuelles et des enseignements validés pour adapter les plans, améliorant ainsi l’efficacité de la livraison, la collaboration et les résultats du programme      Agir en tant qu’agent du changement, en aidant les équipes à s’adapter à l’évolution des exigences, aux incertitudes liées à la recherche et aux priorités de la plateforme       Qualifications Minimales      Licence en ingénierie, en informatique, en gestion d’entreprise ou dans un domaine connexe      Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans la mise en œuvre d’initiatives complexes impliquant plusieurs équipes, au sein d’environnements techniques en constante évolution      Au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans un poste de TPM, de chef de produit, d’architecte logiciel ou dans un rôle similaire      Solide compréhension des plateformes cloud et des systèmes distribués, y compris les API et les services sur AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud      Connaissance pratique des concepts d’IA/ML et du cycle de vie du développement logiciel, notamment de l’utilisation des outils assistés par l’IA dans la mise en œuvre      Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes, avec la capacité d’influencer des publics tant techniques que non techniques      Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, avec une orientation vers l’action et les résultats       Qualifications Souhaitées      Expérience dans la mise en œuvre de programmes d’IA/ML, d’IA générative, de plateformes de données ou de programmes allant de la recherche à la production      Connaissance des systèmes d’IA tels que l’entraînement et l’évaluation de modèles, l’inférence et le service, ou encore les bases de données de recherche et vectorielles      Compréhension des concepts de responsabilité en matière d’IA, de gouvernance des données, de confidentialité et de conformité      Passion pour l’excellence opérationnelle, l’amélioration des processus et les pratiques de livraison évolutives         Learn More         About Autodesk     Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.
